issues.summary: Absent Device MCP outputSchema is classified as schema mismatch.
issues.currentBehavior: An absent output schema is normalized to an empty property set, so required output fields become missing.
issues.requiredOutcome: Permit undeclared output only when an operation-specific runtime result validator exists.

issues.summary: UGV result validation assumes one common rigid result contract.
issues.currentBehavior: Common tools are required to expose error_code, message, mission_id, state and state_label; state 5 is treated as a protocol contradiction.
issues.requiredOutcome: Use tool-specific result policies and classify defined device business failures separately from transport/protocol uncertainty.

issues.summary: Operation and tool contract facts are duplicated.
issues.currentBehavior: Required tools, variants, schemas, capabilities and health dependencies have separate tables or hard-coded branches.
issues.requiredOutcome: Create a shared Vehicle Operation Profile for operation, variant and phase facts.

issues.summary: Preflight and Runtime admission do not consume one qualification verdict.
issues.currentBehavior: Preflight validates its own required-tool subset while Runtime admission combines separate compatibility and availability checks.
issues.requiredOutcome: Create one Operation Qualification Service from profile, captured contract, tool health, variant and phase.

issues.summary: UGV_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE hides the exact qualification cause.
issues.currentBehavior: Missing, unhealthy and schema-incompatible required tools converge on a generic operation denial.
issues.requiredOutcome: Return stable public denial plus bounded internal diagnostics naming tool, phase and qualification cause.

issues.summary: Multi-step mutating operations lack a durable step journal.
issues.currentBehavior: Only coarse execution state, mission IDs and Device MCP call audits persist; intent/dispatching/accepted/rejected/uncertain phases do not.
issues.requiredOutcome: Persist mutation journal entries using Provider database conventions only.

issues.summary: Post-dispatch local validation and persistence failures are not uniformly uncertain.
issues.currentBehavior: Transport failures after a mutating request become uncertain, while some invalid or unpersistable responses can be classified as ordinary protocol/technical failure.
issues.requiredOutcome: Any ambiguity after dispatch becomes uncertain and is never automatically replayed.

issues.summary: A primary mission accepted before dependent follow-up has no explicit orphan state.
issues.currentBehavior: The mission ID can persist, but the lifecycle cannot represent a READY mission whose follow-up was never safely completed.
issues.requiredOutcome: Persist an explicit orphan READY mission state and recovery decision.

issues.summary: Task, control and physical deadlines are incomplete or use an indirect baseline.
issues.currentBehavior: One physical-confirmation timeout is derived from captured observation baselines; recon and control phases have no complete persisted deadline model.
issues.requiredOutcome: Persist explicit phase deadlines and drive terminal decisions with an injected clock.

issues.summary: Restart recovery cannot prove safe resume versus do-not-replay for every crash point.
issues.currentBehavior: Recovery restores executions and arbitration, then refreshes observations without a journal-backed dispatch decision.
issues.requiredOutcome: Recover from persisted journal state and prove mutation dispatch counts across crash points.

issues.summary: Freshness is domain-level rather than field-level.
issues.currentBehavior: Position and speed share chassis freshness, so a fresh speed sample can mask a stale position sample.
issues.requiredOutcome: Record field authority and freshness without changing the frozen external schema.

issues.summary: Geodetic and local-frame positions are not a unified discriminated authority.
issues.currentBehavior: GNSS latitude/longitude and nav_state positionX/Y/Z occupy separate snapshot shapes, while navigation displacement uses Haversine only.
issues.requiredOutcome: Compute displacement only between compatible geodetic or local-frame authorities.

issues.summary: Stationary confirmation does not prove a continuous stable window.
issues.currentBehavior: The latest speed sample and elapsed observation time are used; stationaryCandidateSince and minimum samples are not modeled.
issues.requiredOutcome: Persist/reset a continuous stationary candidate and require a configured minimum sample count.

issues.summary: UGV primary and secondary task-state conflicts are not governed.
issues.currentBehavior: The generic ingress supports taskStateAuthority and NPC configures it, but UGV_MQTT_PROFILE leaves it undefined while mission and composite topics can both patch mission state.
issues.requiredOutcome: Configure UGV source priority and stable conflict behavior.

issues.summary: Weakly correlated reconnaissance observations can drive terminal state too strongly.
issues.currentBehavior: Missing observed recon identity is accepted for association and can still contribute to a successful terminal verdict.
issues.requiredOutcome: Enforce explicit correlation policy and prevent weak evidence from independently proving success.

issues.summary: Some no-observation paths can remain active indefinitely.
issues.currentBehavior: Navigation has a bounded physical-confirmation path, but recon and parts of task control lack equivalent persisted no-observation deadlines.
issues.requiredOutcome: Apply phase deadlines and explicit confirmation outcomes to navigate, recon, pause, resume and cancel.

issues.summary: Emergency Stop admission and execution require cleanup tools in addition to the primary stop tool.
issues.currentBehavior: The flow issues motion stop plus chassis terminate, recon terminate and unlock, and confirmation expects all tracks cleaned up.
issues.requiredOutcome: Admit on ugv_motion_stop, journal it as primary, run cleanup best-effort and confirm independently.

issues.summary: Emergency Stop preemption is not a durable task relationship.
issues.currentBehavior: Track ownership and preemption are in-memory arbitration facts and are not reconstructible as task relationships after restart.
issues.requiredOutcome: Persist preemptor/preempted identities and reconcile them after restart.

issues.summary: External device-owned active work is not part of admission.
issues.currentBehavior: Admission considers local track ownership but does not reserve tracks from authoritative device observations that are not owned by a local execution.
issues.requiredOutcome: Represent external occupancy and reject conflicting local dispatch without inventing ownership.

issues.summary: Public VehicleState and capability schemas remain broad and raw device status leaks upward.
issues.currentBehavior: vehicle_get_state includes deviceStatus and output schemas use broad additionalProperties contracts.
issues.requiredOutcome: Freeze development DTO schemas, remove raw deviceStatus and attach bounded execution-linked evidence metadata.

issues.summary: Operation health dependencies are broad and recovery is not exact to variant and phase.
issues.currentBehavior: Health tracking iterates broad OPERATION_REQUIRED_TOOLS and recovery success increments from any relevant healthy update rather than a bounded exact probe.
issues.requiredOutcome: Derive exact health dependencies from the shared profile and implement bounded half-open recovery.

issues.summary: Provider startup is dependency-connect-first rather than service-ready-first.
issues.currentBehavior: main awaits runtime.initialize before MQTT and gRPC server startup; Device MCP failure can prevent the service exposing NOT_READY health.
issues.requiredOutcome: Start the server in NOT_READY, connect asynchronously, wait for initial observations, recover and then become READY.

issues.summary: Historical reports and qualification matrices can drift from code.
issues.currentBehavior: Facts are emitted by multiple scripts and some historical reports name obsolete paths or retain superseded qualification claims.
issues.requiredOutcome: Generate reports from the shared operation profile and current verified source revision.

issues.summary: There is no focused development Provider-template Compose or controlled one-shot LIVE validator.
issues.currentBehavior: Existing deployments are qualification and production delivery stacks; deploy/development/ugv-provider-template is absent.
issues.requiredOutcome: Add explicit mock/external development profiles, no automatic fallback, and a one-shot guarded LIVE validator.
